extracted.intended_audience: Community college administrators and faculty seeking direct funding for vocational education programs (California Community Colleges or other federal/state agencies)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writing technical grant proposals to obtain direct funding for vocational education programs, including how to interpret RFPs and prepare section-by-section proposal components and budgets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall proposal-writing tips
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides overall tips on proposal writing, underscoring the importance of brainstorming, breaking down the task of proposal writing into manageable pieces, and including appropriate and documented references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize prewriting activities (brainstorming), divide the work into manageable chunks, and support claims with documented references. General tips and examples are provided throughout the resource.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understanding the Request for Proposal (RFP) process
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains the RFP process, including a hypothetical RFP and an outline of the RFP format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes an outline of typical RFP structure and a hypothetical example to illustrate expectations. Offers a list of tasks to complete before beginning to write the proposal to ensure compliance with RFP requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-writing checklist / tasks before writing
rubrics_metrics.description: A list of tasks to complete before beginning to write the proposal (preparatory steps tied to the RFP and project design).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform these preparatory tasks to clarify scope, eligibility, required documents, deadlines, and evaluation criteria before drafting; the package provides specific items to check.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover page
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines for preparing the proposal cover page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advice and examples for necessary cover-page elements (e.g., agency, project title, applicant organization, contact information). Tips/examples are provided to ensure the cover page meets funder expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for writing the proposal abstract (project summary).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on concise summarization of project goals, activities, target population, and expected outcomes; examples illustrate appropriate length and content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table of contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice on preparing a clear table of contents for the proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure sections and page numbers align with proposal organization and RFP requirements; examples demonstrate common organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction / Needs statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on crafting the introduction and needs statement describing the problem or need the project will address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show how to present evidence of need, local data, and context to justify the project; includes tips and examples on framing the problem persuasively and succinctly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goals and objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for stating project goals and measurable objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Differentiate between broad goals and specific, measurable objectives; provide guidance/examples on writing objectives that are time-bound and assessable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures / Activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on describing the specific procedures and activities that will be implemented to meet objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include clear, chronological descriptions of activities, responsibilities, and methods. Examples illustrate how to link activities to objectives and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations for preparing a project timeline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a realistic schedule showing when activities will occur and milestones will be achieved; examples and templates are offered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project management
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on describing project management structure, staffing, and administrative oversight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain roles, responsibilities, qualifications of key personnel, and management procedures to ensure project success; examples show organization charts or management plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Locations and facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for documenting project locations, facilities, and resources available to support the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe physical sites, equipment, and institutional support; provide evidence that facilities are adequate for proposed activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on designing the project evaluation component.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe evaluation questions, methods, data collection, analysis plans, and how evaluation will inform improvement; examples/tips for measurable outcomes and assessment strategies are provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dissemination
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations for plans to disseminate project results and materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe target audiences, dissemination channels, timelines, and products (reports, presentations, training); include strategies to share lessons learned and sustain impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to include a statement of compliance with funder regulations and eligibility criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure proposal explicitly states compliance with applicable federal/state/funder rules and any statutory requirements; include necessary certifications or attestation language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendixes
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on preparing appendixes to include supporting documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use appendixes for resumes, letters of support, supplemental data, and other required attachments; tips on what to include and how to format appendices are provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost proposal and detailed budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Assistance in preparing the cost proposal and a detailed budget to accompany the technical proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes how to present budget line items, justification/narrative for costs, allowable vs. unallowable costs, and examples of budget formats. Tips for aligning budget to activities and RFP constraints are provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist of major issues and components
rubrics_metrics.description: A checklist summarizing major issues and proposal components to verify completeness and compliance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the checklist to confirm all sections, attachments, and compliance items are present before submission; serves as final quality-control step.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stylistic recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: Stylistic guidance for proposal writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendations on writing style, clarity, conciseness, and presentation; the package offers stylistic tips and examples to improve readability and professionalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of resources
rubrics_metrics.description: A list of additional resources to assist in proposal development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References to further readings, templates, agencies, and support materials to help applicants prepare stronger proposals.
